mathematics.logical_review: The general_weights manuscript received independent full mathematical and exposition readings, with a separate reconstruction of the general-n Ore exhaustion proof. Primary-source applications were checked. The earlier graded Ore review is retained below; the old indexed Z-algebra proofs were not reaudited in this update. These are AI-assisted readings, not formalization or external peer review.

graded_ore_review.scope: Connected locally finite left/right noetherian graded C-algebras, AS dimension 4, minimal degrees (1,1,2,3), and prescribed Hilbert series; graded isomorphisms.
checked: AS duality and resolution shifts
plane embedding in a division ring
dual-resolution coefficient lemma and invariance under lifts
cubic projection ranks and first automorphism invertibility
Hilbert-series proof of PBW and final Ore structure
reverse construction and graded Ext from the cited ungraded theorem
finite coefficient equations
necessity and sufficiency of all triangular graded isomorphisms
word-quadratic specialization and linear isomorphism-existence test
graded_ore_review.primary_sources: LPWZ Lemmas 1.1 and 1.3; LWW Theorem 3.3, Lemma 1.3, sections 1.2 and 1.3, and the precise short-exact-sequence statement of Remark 2.2; Sierra Theorem 1.2.
graded_ore_review.limitations: No formal proof assistant, external peer review, novelty determination, or claim that this solves the full indexed classification.

general_weights_review.scope: Connected locally finite left/right noetherian graded C-algebras with minimal generator degrees (1^n,2,3), global dimension n+2, and H(t)=1/((1-t)^n(1-t^2)(1-t^3)). Word-quadratic objects are word-Koszul with relation counts (binom(n,2),n,n,1), without assuming a domain. The domain part has an exhaustive canonical two-step Ore description and explicit graded-isomorphism orbits. General non-word-quadratic exhaustion is not proved for n>=3.
checked: AS duality, regrading, index and four-strand resolution bounds
Bigraded Frobenius Ext and the excess-zero bar subcomplex
Unit-circle Hilbert-polynomial arguments and the relation counts without domain assumptions
Application of the regular normal-element theorem in word degree one
Two-variable Hilbert series of A/(z), finite generation from both noetherian hypotheses, and the growth contradiction proving Bw=wB
Derivation of quotient domain and base AS-regularity after the freeness argument
PBW spanning, Hilbert comparison, and both directions of the general-n quadratic Ore classification
Finite coefficient equations for general homogeneous Ore data
Necessity and sufficiency of all triangular graded isomorphisms
Linear isomorphism-existence criterion for word-quadratic presentations
Double Ore triangularization with the genuine double-extension hypotheses
Unbounded-dimension family, exact minimal generators, Hilbert series and canonical-subalgebra obstruction
Injection of base isomorphism classes and the explicit Sklyanin plane calculation
Definitions, proof dependencies, bibliography, repetition and rendered-page layout
general_weights_review.primary_sources: LPWZ Lemma 1.1 and Theorem 1.9; Rogalski-Zhang Lemma 1.1 and Corollary 1.2; LWW Lemma 1.3, Theorem 3.3 and sections 1.2-1.3; Carvalho-Lopes-Matczuk Definition 1.1 and Theorem 2.2(a),(b); Iyudu-Shkarin Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 6.1; Levasseur Theorem 6.2(i).
general_weights_review.limitations: The classification is exhaustive within the stated word-quadratic domain locus, relative to the AS-regular base class B_n. Neither a classification of all bases nor removal of the additional hypotheses is claimed. No formal proof assistant, external peer review or novelty determination.

coverage: diagonal twist action rank and full invariant lattice
